product: EMIT L3 Aggregated Mineral Spectral Abundance and Uncertainty 0.5 Deg V002
attribution: Robert Green. 2025. EMIT L3 Aggregated Mineral Spectral Abundance and Uncertainty 0.5 Deg V002. NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/EMIT/EMITL3ASA.002
method: Each res-6 cell whose centre lies in the region box takes the value of the grid pixel containing its centre (nearest-pixel sampling, as for the NASA POWER layers); neighbouring cells repeat values. EMIT L3 aggregated spectral abundance (baseline estimate) per mineral; only pixels EMIT observed carry values.
sampling: nearest grid pixel at each cell centre
